execute store result score #r mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/tag_add {selector:"@e[tag=t.p]",tag:"t.x"}
execute store result score #r mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/tag_remove {selector:"@e[tag=t.p]",tag:"t.x"}
function mcdp_lib:player/random {selector:"@e[tag=t.p]",tag:"t.it"}
function mcdp_lib:player/random {selector:"@e[tag=t.p]",tag:"t.it"}
execute store result score #r mcdp_lib_t if entity @e[tag=t.it]
execute store success score #ok mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/random {selector:"@e[tag=t.nobody]",tag:"t.it2"}

execute store result score #r mcdp_lib_t if entity @e[tag=t.it]
execute as @n[type=minecraft:marker,tag=t.p1] store result score #u1 mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/uid
execute as @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=t.p,tag=!t.p1,limit=1] store result score #u2 mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/uid
execute as @n[type=minecraft:marker,tag=t.p1] store result score #u3 mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/uid

summon minecraft:armor_stand 5 -60 5 {Tags:["t.s"],Rotation:[90f,0f],equipment:{head:{id:"minecraft:diamond_helmet",count:1,components:{"minecraft:unbreakable":{}}},mainhand:{id:"minecraft:stick",count:3}}}
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] run function mcdp_lib:player/save_position
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] run function mcdp_lib:player/save_inventory
tp @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] 9 -60 9 0 0
item replace entity @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] armor.head with minecraft:dirt
item replace entity @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] armor.feet with minecraft:iron_boots
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] at @s run function mcdp_lib:player/restore_inventory
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] run function mcdp_lib:player/restore_position
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] store success score #ok mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/save_gamemode
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] store success score #ok mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/restore_gamemode
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] store success score #ok mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:player/save_state

execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.s] run function mcdp_lib:player/forget
